summary: Strings aren't trusted as templates by default; plugins that create strings with embedded templates must use `trust_as_template` from `ansible.template` to make them renderable. The API is incomplete.
questions: How does a plugin mark a string as a trusted template?
Why aren't templates created by my plugin rendering?

answer_card.title: Apply template trust with trust_as_template
answer_card.answer_md:
String values are no longer trusted as templates by default. Strings from playbooks, vars files and other built-in sources are usually trusted automatically. If your plugin **creates new strings that contain templates**, tag them with `trust_as_template` from `ansible.template` so they can be rendered.

Note: this section and its public API are currently incomplete.
